overrides.reason: The Color function receives the reflected ColorTable singletons as its prototype chain, so the complete constant set is generated from those tables at runtime.
ColorNativeObject resolves mutators and forwarded Colors functions through its overridden has/get implementation.
The public table properties are generated by mapping ColorTable singleton classes and lowercasing their reflected class names.
GlobalClasses resolves the public @JvmField declarations in Classes by name and exposes them as NativeJavaClass globals.
ResponseBodyNativeObject adds annotated convenience functions while forwarding other keys to okhttp3.ResponseBody.
ResponseWrapper builds the script-facing HTTP response object by inserting a fixed property set and dynamic lowercase header keys.
HttpSaveResult installs fixed result getters and an annotated isSuccess function on the returned native object.
MediainfoNativeObject installs stream-query functions from MediaInfo.StreamKind and metadata sections parsed from the inspected file.
The augmentable Mime function inherits its conversion helpers and generated IANA constant registry from the legacy runtime Mime prototype.
Calling mime returns JsMime, whose @JvmField values are exposed by Rhino as the parsed result object.
util.morseCode returns MorseCodeNativeObject, which installs annotated functions and pattern/code accessors.
The nested module key is computed from OcrMode.MLKIT.value; the enum value is the stable public name mlkit.
The nested module key is computed from OcrMode.PADDLE.value; the enum value is the stable public name paddle.
The nested module key is computed from OcrMode.RAPID.value; the enum value is the stable public name rapid.
pinyin.convert attaches a bound compact function directly to each returned NativeArray.
RootAutomatorNativeObject forwards the public methods of its wrapped CoreRootAutomator object and binds returned functions.
Selector iterates UiSelector methods and installs the script-interface methods as global selector functions.
SQLite.CursorWrapper delegates Android Cursor and adds the annotated script convenience methods.
sqlite returns a Rhino-wrapped Database that exposes its public Java methods and delegated Android SQLite operations.
storages.create returns StorageNativeObject, which installs the annotated Getter methods plus name and size properties.
The UI augmentable proxies arbitrary script keys to the runtime UI object and view lookup, so the key set is script- and layout-dependent.
UI assigns the annotated UIWidget functions and the mutable __attrs__ registry to every ui.Widget prototype at runtime.
VersionCodes.Info.toNativeObject constructs the fixed search-result properties and valueOf function dynamically.
threads.volatile returns VolatileDisposeNativeObject and installs its annotated synchronization functions at construction time.
The WebSocket constructor returns a Rhino-wrapped CoreWebSocket instance whose Java methods form the instance API.
WebSocketFields reflects the CoreWebSocket companion properties by requested key.
Every zip operation returns ZipNativeObject, which installs its function and property lists at construction time.
